summary: Iteration 36 targeted testing completed for Tap Lyrics/Tap for Cut and project persistence. Backend persistence regression passed (3/3). Frontend desktop core flows passed, but mobile Tap Lyrics open via More menu is not reliable in real run and needs fix/retest.

ui_bugs.issue: Tap Lyrics action from mobile More button did not consistently open Tap Lyrics overlay in automated real run (timeout waiting taplyrics-overlay after mob-taplyrics-btn click).

integration_issues.flow: Frontend runnable script for full Tap Lyrics suite
integration_issues.issue: Frontend script stops on mobile Tap Lyrics open timeout, so full scripted run cannot complete end-to-end in one pass.

issues: Onboarding modal overlay frequently blocks interaction layers during testing; can mask tap tool actions until explicitly closed.

action_items: Fix mobile Tap Lyrics open path from More menu so click reliably opens #tapLyricsOverlay on 390px viewport.
Harden/stabilize onboarding overlay dismissal so it does not block tool entry flows.
Re-run full frontend iteration36 script after mobile fix.
Optional: add explicit redo support for lyrics timing history if redo is expected in acceptance criteria (only undo is present).
critical_code_review_comments: No redo pathway found in studio runtime despite undo support and requirement mention of undo/redo for timing replacement flows.
Tap tool entrypoints depend on layered overlays/sheets with weak deterministic state hooks, causing mobile interaction fragility.
seed_data_creation: Created disposable QA projects via /api/projects during backend and browser checks; all were deleted in-test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop validations confirmed: tap-lyrics-open works, prefill from excerpt words works, empty disables start, special chars accepted, capture increments exactly +1 per tap/Space, complete take enables Apply, partial take disables Apply, cancel keeps M.words unchanged, Tap for cut count cancel clears TAP.session, BeatTapAudio pre-roll ratio measured ~3.99 and playbackRate/offset looked correct, persistence create/get/delete passed. Blocker remains mobile More -> Tap Lyrics open reliability.
rca of the issue: Mobile Tap Lyrics entry likely impacted by sheet/overlay interaction state (mobSheet layer + onboarding or viewport constraints). Reproduction: set mobile viewport, open Studio More sheet, click mob-taplyrics-btn, then wait for [data-testid='taplyrics-overlay']; overlay may fail to appear or button is out of viewport. Mitigation: ensure mobile sheet keeps action button in viewport and TapLyrics.open is called after sheet transition completion with deterministic state checks.
